subject.title: [Feature]: 3 architecture improvements — bootstrap relevance, incremental compaction, observation extraction

question: Which part of this broad architecture request should OpenClaw core own first, and which parts should move to existing plugin or context-engine trackers?
rationale: Current main only partially addresses bootstrap relevance and already exposes compaction/plugin seams, so choosing a generic bootstrap relevance algorithm or promoting observation extraction into core needs maintainer architecture intent.

options.title: Split Into Focused Tracks
options.body: Create or confirm separate trackers for generic bootstrap relevance, compaction architecture, and observation extraction so each can be reviewed with its own owner boundary and proof.

options.title: Keep As Umbrella
options.body: Leave this issue open as a parent architecture discussion and block automated repair until a specific track is prioritized.

options.title: Supersede After Relinking
options.body: Close this issue only after narrower open items cover bootstrap and compaction and maintainers confirm observation extraction should remain outside core.

recommendation.title: Split Into Focused Tracks
recommendation.body: Create or confirm separate trackers for generic bootstrap relevance, compaction architecture, and observation extraction so each can be reviewed with its own owner boundary and proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has already reviewed this issue as unresolved and has the strongest routing signal across the bootstrap and architecture discussion.
